remarks: Summer Country Club Living is Yours in this Immaculate, updated & spacious one bedroom in convenient, well-maintained Wilton community. This cheerful, private nest features an open bright white kitchen with quarts breakfast bar opens to the living/dining area which has plush newer carpet, enjoy a cocktail on the large private balcony overlooking the lawn & trees. This apartment is beautifully appointed featuring crown molding, recessed lighting & walk in closet and comes complete with plenty of parking + visitor parking, and an private, individual storage area. Community residents enjoy the refreshing inground pool & tennis courts!
